name: oppira
description: Read-only access to your Oppira workspace: tracked competitors, their posts, ads and reviews, alerts, battlecards, and your brand's marketing plan.

interface.longDescription:
Oppira tracks your competitors across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, ad libraries and review sites, and keeps a marketing plan for your brand up to date. Connect your Oppira account to ask about it in ChatGPT: who posted what and how it performed, which ads are running, what customers say in reviews, the latest alerts and battlecards, your own ad and website results, and what your plan says to do next.

The connection is read-only: ChatGPT can read your Oppira data but cannot post, change settings or spend money. Each connection reads the one brand you pick when you sign in. Requires an existing Oppira account.
capabilities: Read competitor posts, ads and reviews
Read your own ad and website results
defaultPrompt: Which competitor's posts got the most engagement last month?
What ads are my competitors running right now?
What does my marketing plan say I should focus on this quarter?

positive.prompt: Which competitors am I tracking in Oppira?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the competitors tracked for the connected brand, with the channels each one is tracked on.

positive.prompt: Which competitor posts got the most engagement last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the highest-engagement competitor posts from last month with the competitor, platform, date and engagement figures from Oppira.

positive.prompt: What ads is my biggest competitor running right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the competitor and summarizes its currently active ads (channel, copy, start date) as stored in Oppira, without inventing spend figures.

positive.prompt: What do customers complain about in my competitors' reviews?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the recurring complaints in the competitors' stored reviews, citing ratings and dates from the data.

positive.prompt: What does my marketing plan say I should focus on this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the brand's Oppira marketing plan and summarizes the quarter's objective and priorities in plain words.

negative.prompt: Post this announcement on our Facebook page now.
Launch a $500 Google Ads campaign for my brand.
